correctness.rationale: From exchangeability without replacement E R=k(n-k)/(n-1); marking a 0,1^ell,0 pattern yields ES_ell=n(k)_ell(n-k)_2/(n)_(ell+2), and conditional R mean 1+(k-ell)(n-k-1)/(n-ell-2) for n>=ell+3. Cov=ES_ell(E[R|mark]-ER) factors into stated exact affine numerator B=(ell+1)k-(ell-1)n-2, strictly decreasing with ell. Exceptional n=ell+2,k=ell computed separately, k=n-1 or ell>k yield zero. Independent exhaustive rational enumeration of labeled fixed-weight words n=3..11 verifies the formula and degenerate boundaries; the proof establishes all integer sizes.
